name: Paneer paratha

steps.text: Knead atta with water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough, rest 15 minutes.
Mix crumbled paneer with onion, chilli, coriander, cumin and salt.
Roll two discs per paratha, fill, seal and roll thin, then cook on a hot tava with ghee until browned.
steps.cue: Golden brown spots on both sides, crisp edges and no raw dough visible at the seam.
steps.tip: Keep the filling dry and press it lightly. A wet filling tears the dough.

storage: Cook just before eating. Uncooked stuffed parathas freeze between sheets of baking paper for 1 month and cook from frozen, 1 extra minute a side.
